digest.component_or_area: test fixtures and subprocess environment handling
propositions: Seven @pytest.fixture functions return complete dict(os.environ) copied into subprocess environment mappings or fixture arguments, exposing unrelated ambient credentials
pytest default long traceback renders fixture arguments/locals via saferepr, leaking inherited credential values when unrelated assertions fail
Minimal environment tests (env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin) pass all affected fixtures, proving no behavioral requirement exists for arbitrary ambient inheritance
Each of the seven fixtures must replace broad ambient copy with explicit allowlisted mapping containing only required PATH, state paths, and harness-specific variables
Fixture environment mappings must remain mutable to support existing per-test overrides without adding shared abstraction or production code changes
Verification oracle using synthetic sentinels and forced failures must confirm ambient credentials no longer leak in long traceback output on all seven surfaces
